title: Sharp behavior of the free energy for the two-dimensional directed polymer model
summary: We consider the directed polymer model on $\mathbb{Z}^d$, in an i.i.d.\ random environment $ω=(ω_{n,x})_{n\geq 0,x\in\mathbb Z^d}$, focusing on the critical dimension $d=2$. Our main contribution is to give a sharp lower bound on the free energy in the high-temperature regime. Our proof uses a percolation argument inspired by Lacoin (2010), for which we introduce a key property of bounded ``$\log$-energy'': this property quantifies the regularity of the polymer measures at diffusive scales and we show that it propagates along open paths.
